🇵🇭 🌀 Aftermath of Tropical Storm “Ramil” in the Philippines

At least seven people have died, and several others remain missing after Tropical Storm Ramil swept through the Philippines.

🌧️ Heavy rainfall caused the Jacopon River to overflow in Daram, Samar Province, leading to severe flooding and destruction.

🚨 Rescue teams continue search and recovery operations in the affected areas.

📅 October 19, 2025
🎥 *Video: Joe Patente*

Source: Geól. Sergio Almazán
